name: Mohammad Ali Jauhar
role: Khilafat leader in anti-colonial mass politics
contribution: He helped organize Khilafat mobilization that resonated strongly in Bengal's Muslim public sphere.
context: His politics intersected with non-cooperation, pan-Islamic sentiment, and colonial-era protest networks.
impact: He became a symbolic figure of Muslim political mobilization in the early 1920s.
highlight: A leading voice linking Khilafat politics with mass anti-colonial agitation.
